items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You mentioned, for instance, in one interview, that “Foolkiller” was based on an Edna St. Vincent Millay short story.

ctx.x: That’s a funny one, “...(?)... the world.” Those are later ones.
